summary: Iteration 10 (backend + frontend): tested the restaurant-name setting and the 'Esaurito' flag. Everything requested passes. Backend: new file test_iter10_settings_esaurito.py, 15/15 passing; full regression suite 97/97 passing (run with -n0). Restaurant name: PUT /api/settings trims the name, keeps carta_pubblica_attiva untouched when only the name is sent (and vice versa), rejects 121 chars with 422, accepts 120, and saves whitespace as ''. Staff PUT -> 403, staff GET -> 200, unauthenticated PUT -> 401. GET /api/public/info works without login and returns only nome_ristorante. Esaurito: defaults to false and persists through create, update and GET. /api/public/carta includes esaurito and never prezzo_acquisto, fornitore or foto_path. CSV and XLSX exports have an 'Esaurito' column with Sì/No. Import maps sì/x -> true and empty -> false. An update-mode import whose file has no Esaurito column keeps the existing flag. CSV round-trip preview has 0 errors. UI: the admin /account page shows restaurant-card. Saving updates the sidebar brand, the /carta header and the /carta-digitale header, sets the document title to 'Carta dei Vini — <nome>', and shows a toast. Clearing the name falls back to Ristorante / Selezione and the title 'Carta dei Vini'. Staff users do not see restaurant-card but do see the name in the sidebar. The esaurito checkbox starts unchecked and clicking its label text toggles it. Saving shows the gallery badge, the list badge and the detail badge; unchecking removes all three. Printable /carta shows 'Esaurito' instead of the price. On /carta-digitale (390px, no login) the row shows 'Esaurito' and the sheet shows 'Al momento esaurito'. Regression: create, edit, delete and the 'Cerca e filtra' search all work. At 390px there is no overflow (scrollWidth 390) on the gallery, the wine form or the public page.

issues: On mobile the restaurant name never appears anywhere in the admin app: MobileTop only shows 'Carta dei Vini' and the Brand sidebar is hidden. Consider showing nome_ristorante in MobileTop.

A sold-out wine still shows the price badge next to 'Al momento esaurito'. This is acceptable, but the row hides the price, so the sheet is inconsistent with it. Consider dimming or striking through the price.

action_items: Optional: show the restaurant name in the mobile top header (Layout.jsx MobileTop).

Optional (minor race): in RestaurantForm, the useEffect on settings.nome_ristorante overwrites what the user typed if settings arrive after typing starts, which happens on a slow network. Consider initialising only once, or disabling the input until settings have loaded.
critical_code_review_comments: AccountPage RestaurantForm: the input is editable before useSettings resolves, and the later setNome() overwrites the user's input. I hit this in automation: fill('') ran before settings loaded and the old name was saved. Disable the input while isLoading.

The backend test files use module-scoped cleanup fixtures. Under pytest-xdist (the default -n in this env), the cleanup runs per worker and deletes data another worker still needs. Run with -n0 (the iter10 test failed once under xdist because of this).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ wines (TEST_Default10, TEST_Sold10, TEST_ImpSi10/No10/X10, TEST_UiSold10), temporary staff users test_staff_*@example.com and test_staffui10@example.com, and temporary restaurant names. All deleted or reset. Final state: only Amaranta (untouched by tests) and admin; settings {nome_ristorante: '', carta_pubblica_attiva: true}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend tests with: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/ -n0. Use -n0 because the module cleanup fixtures break under xdist. The iter10 test resets nome_ristorante to '' and carta_pubblica_attiva to true at teardown. Never touch Amaranta.
